resume_text: Built and shipped an internal claims-triage agent at a mid-size insurer: 4-step workflow (intake -> extraction -> policy-match -> human approval), live to 40 adjusters for 7 months, I owned it from prototype to production and maintained it after launch. Designed a human-in-the-loop approval gate because auto-decisioning on claims was an unacceptable risk. Wrote a reusable extraction component the next two teams reused. Comfortable saying when I was wrong: v1 over-automated and I pulled the autonomy back after error analysis.
